verdict.rationale: Codex supports team distribution via `.agents/skills` checked into repo folders, a marketplace mechanism (`codex plugin marketplace add`, marketplace.json manifests), and skills as portable folders installable cross-harness via third-party tooling, all corroborated by a runtime probe showing a real install from the OpenAI curated marketplace. missing for 10: independent large-scale enterprise case studies of team-wide rollout and more detail on access-control/versioning for shared marketplaces.
